note: Places a caller asks about often enough to be worth naming. A location is a box and a resolution, not a wind: the atmosphere over it is whatever the caller brings or whatever HRRR says at the hour. radiusMiles has to hold the landform that shapes the wind - a half-mile box in a canyon contains no canyon and the solve has nothing to act on.

locations.name: Hat Creek Training
locations.note: A 1,700 acre facility east of US-95 overlooking the Seven Devils, with engagements past 2,500 m across canyons. Three miles of radius rather than two because the property is only 1.6 miles square and a 2,500 m shot leaves it: the box has to hold the far side of the canyon as well as the near one, or the walls that shape the wind are outside the domain that solves it. Read at 32 m and not coarser, because the terrain that matters here is the canyon and averaging it away is the one thing that would make this domain look like the flat ones. Expect the staircase mesh: this is not 45-degree-and-under ground.

locations.name: NRA Whittington Center
locations.note: Centred on the firing lines rather than on the property's middle. The previous centre was a guess made before any range coordinate existed, and it was wrong by four to six kilometres: the 1000 yard range sat 879 m west of the box, and a 2,412 yard engagement began 54 m inside the five-mile box's western wall and ended 1,445 m outside it. A shooter watching that map was watching ground the solve never covered. This box holds the 1000 yard range at 36.787902,-104.535953, and the first known engagement from 36.792028,-104.579632 to 36.806557,-104.596452 - 2,205 m on a bearing of 317 - with about 2.1 km of terrain beyond the outermost of them, so the walls that shape the wind are inside the domain that solves it. Read at 16 m: this is the box the shooting actually happens in, and it is the last place to average a canyon away to save runner minutes.

locations.name: King of 2 Miles — firing point 1
locations.note: The engagement, not the property: centred on the midpoint of the shot rather than on a range, so the box holds the line and the ground either side of it with 2.4 km to spare at every edge. Two miles rather than three because this domain exists to answer one question - what the air does between a firing point and a target 2,202 m away on a bearing of 317 - and a box twice the area costs more than twice the solve without adding anything the bullet passes over. Read at 16 m, the finest the 3DEP pyramid offers here; the whittington box covers the same ground more widely and whittington-wide covers the property.

shots.name: Firing point 1 to target 1
shots.note: 2,202 m on 317 degrees - 2,408 yards. Both pins sit more than 2.4 km inside this box, which matters because the boundary is where the solve is least trustworthy: measured at nearly double the interior maximum on the old domain.

locations.name: NRA Whittington Center — whole property
locations.note: The same centre as the 1000 yard box, five miles out and read coarse. This is the whole property and its surrounding landform - what the weather is doing to the Center, rather than what the ground is doing to a particular shot. It still covers the old centre at 36.77,-104.49, so nothing that was visible before this was re-centred has been lost.
